title: Excellent tour.
text: Totally wonderful experience with excellent guides. I was in Barcelona with my parents (both in their late 80’s) and 21 year old son. The guides made it fun and easy for everyone,  across the generations. We learned a lot about Barcelona - both guides were very knowledgeable. More importantly they treated everyone with kindness and respect, brilliant humour and genuine interest in our family. My 88 year old Dad had the time of his life!  Highly recommend.
author: katiemW4613EF

title: Fantastic way to see the...
text: Fantastic way to see the city and a great way to start our time in Barcelona.  Fun, unique and safe.  Joe and Johannis were fantastic guides for our group of 4.
author: Jim_W

title: Best splurge of our time in Barcelona!
text: Talk about the perfect splurge!! This tour is pricey and we almost didn’t do it but SO glad we did! Andre was a fantastic guide/driver/host for our sidecar Barcelona experience! We saw all the “big guns”, took time for photos, coffee stops and anything we particularly wanted to see. Highly recommend!!
author: Deborah_H

title: Sidecar tour
text: Johannes was an excellent guide! He met us at our location and dropped us off at our hotel. We were able to go to all the sections of Barcelona from the beach to the hills and everywhere in between. We learned a lot about the city. Would definitely recommend!
author: 60Karen78

title: The Best Way to See the City:Open-Air Fun in a Motorcycle Cart!
text: Hands down best time ever!!!  It was our first time doing this and would not hesitate to do this again. Fun way to see the city, and the bonus was our amazing guides Stephan and Joppe who had great knowledge of the city!
author: jeannem137

title: Excellent and fun way to...
text: Excellent and fun way to discover Barcelona. Our guide Andrea was really friendly and shared a lot of its history with us!! Thank you again Andrea!!
author: Nigel_C

title: Awesome open road experience
text: IF you love motorcycle rides, this is definitely the tour for you. It was our favorite tour, and pablo art guide/driver could not have done a better job. Tons local knowledge.
author: A3158AGmichaelr

title: They customized our tour around what we had already seen and wanted to see which made for a perfect day!
text: Joppe did a great job! It was raining earlier in the day and they were flexible and able to work around the weather and it ended up being beautiful weather! This was a relaxing and close up way to see different parts of the city. From the side streets, to the overviews, to the beaches, it was great. The stories, history and all of the fun facts we learned out Barcelona along the way made for a fun afternoon.
author: A5931LGsarar

title: Best way to see Barcelona!
text: Really great experience! Such a fun way to see the city. Our guide Diego was really knowledgeable and communication with Brightside was excellent. Highly recommend it!
author: 868sherriel

title: Unique, informative & fun way to explore Barcelona
text:
Had read nothing but positive reviews about this unique & fun tour & it did not disappoint! Joe, our guide, deftly drove us to all points N/S/E/W & by the time our tour ended, we walked away thinking we had seen the best of what this beautiful city has to offer. Everywhere we went, we were met w/ smiles, thumbs ups & joyful curiosity. How often do any of us get that kind of gleeful response in this day & age?
My husband really enjoyed riding in the sidecar, while I preferred sitting behind Joe. And while driving in the midst of traffic isn't for the faint of heart, Joe was an alert & cautious
author: cjob888
